notes.title: Update Patch v.1.3.0.10
notes.content:
-Added the "Advanced" combat setting.
-Added the Bottomless Labs to Terminal Creed.
-Added five new Customs.
-Added four new weapons.
-Added the six winning pieces of the fan-art contest.


-Reduced the number of levels of Terminal Karma from four to three.
-Changed the Keepers of each level in Terminal Karma to those of the other stages.
-Banned MC skills from use in the Virtual Missions.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.2.4
notes.content:
-Added the Christmas Custom gears "Stellar Pixie" and "Snow Pixie."


-Fixed an issue in which the camera angle would not return to normal after a Take-down.
-Fixed an issue in which Rona can get caught outside the gate at the start of battle.
-Fixed an issue in which Rona could get immobilized at the same time as defeating a boss.
-Fixed an issue in which Chain-skills would be unleashed multiple times at once.
-Fixed an issue in which Shutty would malfunction when unleashing ranged attacks.
-Fixed an issue in which, when the MC skill "Ice Time" is unleashed while an enemy is evading, that enemy would freeze out of bounds.
-Fixed an issue in which Core energy would not be lost when receiving damage while the bugged Core "Leaky Core" is installed.
-Fixed an issue in which operation by controller would malfunction.


-Altered settings so that Core Chargers would appear randomly in the battlefield.
-Lowered the probability of Core Chargers dropping when viral Cores are installed.
-Lowered the HP of Keepers in Terminal Karma.
-Lowered the HP of high-hazard level robots.
-Altered settings so that enemies are not knocked back when hit by Rona with the Super-core "Dash" installed.
-Lowered the attack power of the weapon "Four Tigers."

notes.title: ***READ ME IN FULL*** Regarding the C Key Command Issue
notes.content:
Regarding the issue described below, reported by so many, we must ask for some more time to completely solve it.

[The Issue]
-The key command at the Title screen becomes displayed as C and the game cannot proceed.
-All key commands in the Settings screen become displayed as C.

[Temporary Solution]
***Precautions***
    Please take the utmost caution when working in the Registry Editor.
   -We do not take responsibility for any damages that may arise from the usage of the Registry Editor.
   -Do not carry out the following procedure if you are not experiencing the issue described above.

Procedure
1. Make sure the latest update is applied.
2. Open the PC's Registry Editor.
3. Delete the registry "Studio HG."
4. Restart the game.

If the above does not solve the issue, backup and delete your save files, located in the folder below:

C:\Users\[your username]\AppData\LocalLow\STUDIO HG\MetallicChild\MC_Save.sav

Note: The above folder is hidden by default, please set hidden files to be shown when navigating to this folder.


If the issue persists after taking all of the above steps,
please contact our Customer Service:
https://www.metallic-child.com/en/support.php

We apologize for the trouble and inconvenience.

notes.title: *UPDATED*[IMPORTANT NOTICE] Regarding the METALLIC CHILD Original Soundtrack
notes.content:
We have finally identified and fixed the issues that have been pointed out in the forums regarding the METALLIC CHILD Original Soundtrack.

The issues that have been fixed are as follows:
- The track "Chasing (Arranged)" was accidentally replaced by a version of the track "Theme of Icela."
- The version of "Run, Run" included in the album was an older version which differed from the actual track used in the game.
Note: The older version of "Run, Run" is still included in the album, but renamed as "Run, Run (Initial Version)."

Yes, it's quite late, but here is the link to the store page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1759770/METALLIC_CHILD_Original_Soundtrack/


Those who have already purchased the album,
please follow the steps below to obtain the updated files.

-Automatic updates enabled:
Go to your library, open up the METALLIC CHILD Original Soundtrack, and click "Browse Local Files" to open up the download folder (METALLIC CHILD Original Soundtrack).

-Automatic updates disabled:
First, go to your library, open up the METALLIC CHILD Original Soundtrack, and click "Update."
Then, click "Browse Local Files" to open up the download folder (METALLIC CHILD Original Soundtrack).

-If the above does not work:
1. Go to your library, open up the METALLIC CHILD Original Soundtrack, and click "Browse Local Files" to open up the download folder (METALLIC CHILD Original Soundtrack) and delete the folder.
2. Right click the METALLIC CHILD Original Soundtrack in the ALL list on the left side of the library window, select Manage, click Uninstall to uninstall the soundtrack.
   Note: If the METALLIC CHILD Original Soundtrack does not appear in the ALL list,
             open the drop-down list above and select SOUNDTRACKS in the list.
3. Open up again, the METALLIC CHILD Original Soundtrack, and click "Download Album" to install the updated soundtrack.
4. Then, click "Browse Local Files" to open up the download folder (METALLIC CHILD Original Soundtrack).

Please accept our apologies for taking so long to resolve this problem.
We thank all of you who have contributed to drawing attention to this issue.
